pancreas | Pancréatite aiguë biliaire |.description: edit Abdominal ultrasonography of an 83 year old man who experienced biliary colic two weeks prior. It shows a gallbladder wall that is almost pathologically thickened, at 3 mm. However, there is no apparent edema in the pericholecystic fat. The gallbladder contains biliary sludge , as well as gallstones , which create acoustic shadowing . There is thus gallstones without current cholecystitis .
